title: Dhoom Machi Dhoom
body:
Dhoom machi dhoom aamad hai mere maula Ali ki
Jhoom lo jhoom aaj khushi hai hai mere maula Ali ki
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kaabe ke hothon pa hansi hai
Kiske aane ki yeh khushi hai maula
Hai yeh wahi jis per naazan sab ka nabi hai
2.Mere maula mere aaqa tu hai saare jag ka data maula
Har mushkil naam se tere pal mein tali hai
3.Sadqe mein aulade Ali ke
Sab ki murad puri hoye maula
Sadqe me...tere sari duniya pali hai
4.Shor utha ek salle ala ka
Khil utha har ek ka chehra maula
Aamad se aaj kali har dil ki khili hai
5.Tara utra jis ke dar per hai ye wahi damad de payambar maula
Koi hai khush aag kisi ke dil me lagi hai
6.Goonjti hai naron se mehfil
Taare bhi hain jhilmil jhilmil maula
Teri khushi donon jahan mein phaili hui hai
7.Teri shujaat ka kya kehna
Shahe marda sher e yazdaan maula
Khaibar shikan tujh sa jahan mein duja nahi hai
8.Hai yah sohail ab tera fidayi
Sadqe mein tere fikr hai payi
Sham o seher uske labon per per naame Ali hai
